description: This file defines the 'execution_events' package, including data structures, constants, and functions for managing execution events and broadcasting them via an event bus in a concurrent environment.

classes.name: ExecutionEvent
classes.description: Represents an execution state change event with details such as type, IDs, status, timestamp, and data.

classes.name: ExecutionEventBus
classes.description: Manages subscribers and broadcasting of execution events in a thread-safe manner.

methods.name: NewExecutionEventBus
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of ExecutionEventBus.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Adds a new subscriber channel to the event bus.

methods.name: Unsubscribe
methods.description: Removes a subscriber channel from the event bus.

methods.name: Publish
methods.description: Broadcasts an execution event to all subscribers.

methods.name: GetSubscriberCount
methods.description: Returns the current number of active subscribers.

methods.name: ToJSON
methods.description: Serializes an ExecutionEvent to a JSON string.
